name: io.github.bosekarmegam/qoregeo
title: QOREgeo GIS
description: Zero-dependency GIS: distances, geofences, CSV/GeoJSON filters, OpenStreetMap maps, geocoding

environmentVariables.name: QOREGEO_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Folder the tools may read and write (default: the working directory)

environmentVariables.name: QOREGEO_ALLOW_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to enable geocoding via OpenStreetMap Nominatim
